answers.core: It's a rather straightforward feature but the +250k godot-tools users on VSCode might welcome the fact that they're thought of, appreciated and supported <3
answers.workaround:
## Workaround for the user
- Hold-Ctrl Drag'n Drop the node into some random script (make sure it's not a project relevant file)
   - onready variable instruction will be created
- Cut the onready variable instruction out
- Paste the instruction into VSCode

title: Copy onready variable instructions to clipboard for use in external editors
